reconstructed_captions.12: The axe strikes the wood, splitting it cleanly.
reconstructed_captions.13: The person gathers the pieces of split kindling into a pile.
reconstructed_captions.14: The person sets down the axe and picks up the collected kindling.
reconstructed_captions.15: The person kneels by a prepared fire lay on a log platform.
reconstructed_captions.16: A close-up shows a tinder bundle made of dry, fibrous material.
reconstructed_captions.17: The person readies a bow drill set to create an ember.
reconstructed_captions.18: The person begins spinning the spindle on the fireboard, creating friction.
reconstructed_captions.19: Smoke begins to rise from the point of contact on the fireboard.
reconstructed_captions.20: A small pile of hot, black dust forms in the notch of the fireboard.
reconstructed_captions.21: The person stops drilling and carefully taps the board to release the dust pile.
reconstructed_captions.22: A glowing ember is visible within the pile of wood dust.
reconstructed_captions.23: The person carefully transfers the ember into the tinder bundle.
reconstructed_captions.24: The person gently blows on the tinder bundle to feed oxygen to the ember.
reconstructed_captions.25: The tinder bundle begins to smolder and produce a large amount of smoke.
reconstructed_captions.26: The tinder bundle bursts into flame, ready to light the fire.
